newsitem.title: UK: Transporter TNT to have new corporate identity.
newsitem.headline: Transporter TNT to have new corporate identity.

text.p: TNT said it had awarded South African company KSDP Design Group a contract to develop a new corporate identity programme for the express freight and transport company.
A statement received here by Dutch post and telecoms group KPN, which took over TNT at the start of this year, said the new identity would be revealed in 1998.
But KPN decline to disclose how much the image revamp would cost.

It said that while maximising "the equity in the TNT name", the new corporate identity would reflect the creation of a new company that would be a "worldwide leader in global express distribution, international business mail and logistics".
The statement added that TNT, now based in Amsterdam, was expected to have 1997 sales of about nine billion guilders ($4.7 billion).
It said that outside of South Africa, KSDP had operations in Amsterdam, London and Sydney and that the Amsterdam office would serve as liaison office for the TNT new identity account.
